reviewKind: author-led fault injection and regression; not independent audit

findings.issue: Web and SDK startup parser exceptions could print a fragment of malformed private credential JSON to stderr.
findings.fix: Catch startup failures and emit application-owned diagnostic codes; omit parser/RPC exception bodies.
findings.verification: Four separate CLI process canary tests in tests-fixed.json; service, Web and SDK success-path regressions.

findings.issue: A real reorg recovered payment but deduplicated an identical service outcome against the old chain context, causing DELIVERY_BEFORE_PAYMENT_CHECKPOINT.
findings.fix: Include registration and settlement block hashes in outcome event identity, keeping the old signed prefix and appending a fresh service observation.
